parsed.rationale: A new analyst cannot access the workspace after accepting an invite and receives an 'access denied' message, while other users can log in normally. This is an account/workspace access issue, not a security incident or data loss based on the provided text.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—thanks for reaching out. I’m sorry the new analyst can’t access the workspace after accepting the invite.

To get this resolved today, could you share a few details so we can pinpoint what’s blocking her access?
1) The exact wording of the “access denied” message (or a screenshot), including any error code if shown.
2) The analyst’s email/username she used when accepting the invite.
3) Which workspace/tenant (workspace name/ID) she’s trying to access, and whether she’s using the same environment as the other users who can log in.
4) Confirm whether she can log in to the account at all, but only fails when opening the workspace—or if she’s blocked immediately after accepting/logging in.
5) The role/permission assigned to her via the invite (and the role of one of the users who can access successfully).

Once we have that, we’ll review the account/workspace permissions for the invited user and help you get her access working.
promised_actions: Review the account/workspace permissions for the invited user once the requested details are provided
Help get the analyst’s workspace access working
safety_notes: Did not promise a refund, SLA, or specific root cause
Did not claim a security determination or broader outage
Requested minimum clarifying details (exact message, identity, workspace/tenant, failure timing, roles)

parsed.customer_impact: The new analyst cannot access the workspace, preventing onboarding and blocking her ability to use the system.
grounded_facts: A new analyst was invited and accepted an invite yesterday.
After accepting the invite, the new analyst receives an “access denied” message.
Other users can log in normally.
The user is requesting help to get the new analyst into the workspace today.
missing_information: The specific error text/details beyond “access denied” (exact wording, error code, or screenshot).
Whether the issue happens immediately after accepting the invite or after attempting to log in.
The workspace identifier/name and which environment/tenant the analyst is trying to access.
The analyst’s account email/username (to confirm which identity is affected).
Whether the invite was assigned the correct role/permissions (and what role other successful users have).
Whether the analyst can log in at all or fails only when accessing a specific workspace/project.
risk_signals: Account/workspace access denial after invite acceptance suggests a permissions or provisioning issue rather than a general outage.
No security incident, data loss, or broader service disruption is indicated, but the error prevents user access.
parsed.summary: After a new analyst accepts an invitation, she receives an “access denied” message and cannot log into the workspace, while other users can log in normally.
